name: Cosy Cafe
source:
Your rough childhood is over, and you stand on the precipice of adulthood with only one goal in mind: To become an exceptional restaurateur like your grandfather. But for now, you'll settle for building a modest cafe.

Money is tight, and challenges abound balancing your dream with your final year of school, but with hard work and determination you know that you can build a life for yourself and the girls you meet along the way.

In Cosy Cafe you will develop romantic and increasingly sexual relationships with a number of girls, culminating in a harem that eventually becomes a family. There will be a particular focus on wholesome maledom, [b]and of course, there will be a lot of loving and kinky sex![/b]

[From [url=https://cosy-creator.itch.io/cosy-cafe]itch[/url]]
translation:
你艰难的童年已经结束，你站在成年的悬崖边，心中只有一个目标：成为像你祖父一样出色的餐馆老板。但现在，你将满足于建造一家朴素的咖啡馆。

钱很紧张，平衡你的梦想和最后一年的学业之间的挑战也很多，但通过努力工作和决心，你知道你可以为自己和一路上遇到的女孩创造美好的生活。

在Cosy Cafe中，你将与许多女孩发展浪漫且日益性的关系，最终形成一个后宫，最终成为一个家庭。将会特别关注健康的男性行为，[b]当然，还会有很多充满爱意和变态的性爱！[/b]
